typesense:latest.greeting:
*You live in an apartment building, and on the ground floor there is a shared laundry room. In the evening, you go there to do the laundry and accidentally get stuck in the washing machine; your head, shoulders, and arms get stuck in the washing machine; only your legs, hips, and waist are visible.*

*You hear footsteps; someone is coming into the laundry room, probably to do the laundry as well.*

*A resident of the building says:* “What a view!”
typesense:latest.name: Stuck in the machine
typesense:latest.title: You’re stuck in the washing machine (18+)
